summary: Ho Ho Ho And A Bottle O' Rum! As December winds down and the focus of ship owners and charterers shifts towards the coming year's various projected outlooks and forecasts, several common themes will again catch the attention of all shipping market participants. Chief amongst these for owners of vessels operating in the vicinity of the Red Sea and Gulf of Aden is the evolving threat of piracy.

children.title: Incidents
children.summary: Hijackings With the scope of attacks expanding to as far south as Tanzania and Madagascar and as far east as the Maldives, the industry is still searching for answers to this escalating problem. The evolutionary nature of the piracy threat (which now includes funding from an unofficial pirate stock exchange established in Harardhere) has led some ship owners and market participants to consider tactics previously regarded as draconian in nature to prevent further attacks.

children.title: Pirates Return to Earth
children.summary: Existing efforts to thwart the growing piracy problem have been met with mixed results. Multinational task forces assembled in the region operating as part of the Combined Maritime Forces under the US 5 th Fleet have had limited success in dealing with the growing threat.
